name: Brute Force
description: Adversaries attempt repeated authentication attempts against a service to guess or crack valid credentials.

name: Valid Accounts
tactic: Defense Evasion, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Initial Access
description: Adversaries obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts to gain initial access, persistence, or elevated privilege.

name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
description: Adversaries exploit software vulnerabilities or misconfigurations to elevate privileges, e.g. unexpected root/sudo activity.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
description: Adversaries abuse shells and scripting interpreters (bash, PowerShell, Python) to execute commands or scripts.

name: Scheduled Task/Job
description: Adversaries use task scheduling utilities (cron, at, Task Scheduler) to execute code on a schedule or as a persistence mechanism.

name: Application Layer Protocol
description: Adversaries use common application layer protocols to blend C2 traffic with legitimate network activity.

name: Ingress Tool Transfer
description: Adversaries transfer tools or files from an external system into the compromised environment, e.g. via curl/wget.

name: Web Protocols
description: Adversaries use HTTP/HTTPS to communicate with C2 infrastructure to blend with normal web traffic.
